title: VDI & End-User Computing Engineer: Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 & Multi-Platform VDI
description: A project-based course that takes working IT professionals from VDI fundamentals to production-grade virtual desktop engineering. You'll master the vendor-neutral core every EUC engineer needs — architecture, display protocols, profile management, licensing, and platform selection across Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix DaaS, and Omnissa Horizon — then go deep on Azure Virtual Desktop mapped to all four AZ-140 exam domains: planning and deploying host pools, images, and autoscaling; securing access with Entra ID and Conditional Access; delivering user environments with FSLogix and app attach; and monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting at scale. You finish with portfolio-grade capstones: a full AVD design-and-build and a multi-platform migration assessment hiring managers actually ask for.
audience: IT professionals — sysadmins, helpdesk tier 2/3, M365/Azure administrators — who want to move into a VDI / End-User Computing Engineer role. Assumes basic Windows administration and some Azure familiarity; prepares you for AZ-140 (Microsoft Certified: Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty) and gives you the cross-platform grounding for Citrix CCA-V and Omnissa OCA-H paths.

moduleTitles.3: Azure Virtual Desktop Infrastructure: Plan, Deploy & Scale
